$comment: Selection policy for scripts/sync-models.mjs. Facts come from models.dev; this file only decides WHICH models to publish and how to label them. Never hand-edit prices here.
$maxAgeDaysComment: A model that is not pinned must have been released within this many days. Without it, raising maxModelsPerProvider to fit new releases also pulled long-retired models back in, because spare slots are filled by whatever exists. Pinned models are published at any age.
$pinnedComment: Always publish these if upstream still lists them, regardless of release date. They carry real search demand, are the cheap tier people compare against, or are used by a comparison page in src/data/comparisons.ts, so newest-first alone would wrongly drop them. tests/model-catalogue.test.ts fails if a comparison page names a model that is not published.
$overridesComment: Facts upstream does not model. Descriptions are editorial. Long-context tiers now come from models.dev where it publishes them; keep a tier here only for models where upstream has none (currently Gemini 2.5 Pro), and the sync warns if both exist. Nothing here may restate a base rate.

gemini-2.5-pro.$visionComment: The fixed media_resolution budgets are exclusive to Gemini 3 models (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/media-resolution). Gemini 2.x keeps the 258-token 768px tile rule.

$correctionsComment: Rare, documented exceptions to the single-source rule, for when models.dev disagrees with the provider's own pricing page. Each entry names the official source, the date it was checked, and the models.dev values it replaces. The sync warns when models.dev starts to agree (remove the entry) or changes again (re-check the source). The browser refresh skips corrected models.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.$visionComment: GPT-6 Astra and the GPT-5.6 family are documented as 32x32 patch models with a 2,500-patch budget and a 1.2 multiplier (developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/images-vision). GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are absent from that table, so the engine applies the same rule and reports an estimate.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.$tokenizerComment: Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer that produces ~30% more tokens for the same text (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing). Models released before Claude Opus 4.7, such as Haiku 4.5, override this back to claude-estimate.

google.label: Google
google.$visionComment: Gemini 3 spends a fixed budget per image: 280 low, 560 medium, 1,120 high and default, 2,240 ultra-high (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/media-resolution).
google.$comment: gemini-3.5-flash is no longer on ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-10-02); 3.5 Flash-Lite still is.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.pricingNote: Rates shown are DeepSeek's off-peak prices. From 01:00 to 04:00 and 06:00 to 10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday (except Chinese public holidays), DeepSeek charges double.
deepseek.$comment: deepseek-v4-flash is a retired name that DeepSeek now routes to V4.1 Flash (deepseek-flash). It is excluded so the same model is not listed twice; the core package keeps it as an alias.

zai.label: Z.ai GLM
zai.$comment: GLM-5 and GLM-5-Turbo are gone from docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing (checked 2026-10-02); 5.1 and 5.2 are still listed.

$serviceTiersComment: Providers sell the same model at several speeds and several prices. Each multiplier applies to every token category and was read from the provider pricing page on 2026-10-02. Only tiers confirmed on an official page are listed here.

openai.label: Batch
openai.note: Asynchronous processing. Half the standard price on every model.

openai.label: Flex
openai.note: Slower responses, billed at batch rates.

openai.label: Fast
openai.note: Priority capacity at twice the standard price.

openai.label: Ultrafast
openai.note: GPT-6 Astra only, and only below the long-context threshold.

anthropic.label: Batch
anthropic.note: Asynchronous processing. Stacks with the cache multipliers.

anthropic.label: Fast mode
anthropic.note: Research preview, Opus models only, on the first-party API.

anthropic.label: US data residency
anthropic.note: inference_geo set to us, on Claude 4.6 and later. Applies to every token category.

google.label: Flex
google.note: Lower-priority capacity for Gemini 4 Argon, billed at the same rates as Batch.

google.label: Priority
google.note: Confirmed for Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash on the pricing page.

deepseek.label: Peak hours
deepseek.note: 01:00 to 04:00 and 06:00 to 10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday. Catalogue rates are the off-peak ones.
